chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: When you're creating and modifying webpages, you can use any professional HTML editor.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: But when you're learning HTML, you should start with a simple text editor like Notepad on PCs

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: or TextEdit on Macs. It's better to start simple before jumping into the deep end.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: Here are four steps to create your first web page. Step one, open Notepad or TextEdit.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: In this video, we will use Notepad.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: Now it's time for step two. Write some HTML.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: Stretch your fingers and then either write or copy some HTML into Notepad.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: Then comes step three. Save your work as an HTML page. Look at you moving along so fast.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: To save it to select file and then save As. Name the file index.html and set the encoding to

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: UTF-8, which is the preferred encoding for all HTML files. HTML files can have HTML or

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: just HTML as file extension. And finally, we reach step four. View the HTML page in a browser.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: Open the saved HTML file in your favourite browser. The result should look like this.

chunks.title: Editors
chunks.text: And just like that, you've created your first HTML page. You should feel very proud.
